To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

ICT is a tool that can be used for user participation in the design process; the level of ICT usage depends on the level of participation; and the level of user participation is dependent of the level of ICT use.
ICT is a useful tool to support user participation.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: 1) How does ICT facilitate user participation and user commitment?
the following issues: - How can ICT support the participation of users in the design and use of the built environment?
the question of how to improve the design process in such a way that it will result in buildings that are better suited to the users' needs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the use of ICT in a participatory process is only one of many factors that determine the success of a participatory process.
user participation is not a panacea, but that it can be a very powerful tool in the right context and with the appropriate support.
user involvement is not a panacea for all problems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
ICT can be used to support user participation in the design process, but it is not the only tool to do so.
user participation is an important tool to improve buildings.

the use of ICT is an important tool for user participation, especially for the participation of users who are not involved in the design process, for the participation of people in the design team and for the involvement of people who are not involved at all in the design process.
The main takeaway from our work is that
user participation and ICT can be useful at all stages in a building’s life cycle, from the design phase to the use of the building.
ICT should not be used as a substitute for user participation, but as a tool to facilitate it.
user involvement and the use of ICT are not a one-size-fits-all solution for all projects, but should be used in a flexible manner.
